This is Bu Xiaogu; I will take you out.
Great — I am right over here.
Xiaogu, I am so sorry — I got your notebook all dirty.
It is fine, it does not matter.

No worries — then let me take you to eat.
Sorry for the intrusion — I will take my leave first.
